LanguageData.ABY_CrownReactorMultilance.label: crown reactor multilance
LanguageData.ABY_CrownReactorMultilance.description: A crown-reactor weapon assembled from Saint-grade containment geometry and dominion rail lattices. Its four parallel emitters do not fire as barrels, but as a synchronized verdict: each discharge wakes the rails in sequence, then releases four long reactor beams that carve armor, nerve and protocol shielding apart.
